description: Connect your Cohuno account to design integration workflows and web-service definitions from ChatGPT. Inspect WSDL, WADL and XSD contracts, discover SOAP operations and endpoints, draft native SOAP and REST processes and polling integrations, validate application source and XML, and test SOAP mappings with explicit mock responses. Review and save new projects to your connected account. Login is required for every tool. Tools author and validate definitions; they do not invoke live endpoints, activate pollers or deploy services.

defaultPrompt: Help me design a Cohuno integration process using supported activities, then validate its application source.
